PLAN: Restore the demonstrated best 0.540 plant (R899) now, then use at most the remaining solves for a low-risk final improvement only if clearly justified.
Boil-up 0.1 over-strips ethane into TTTB, dropping C3 purity to 91% and losing the blend sale; 0.5 is optimal among tested values. R899 combines stripper boil-up 0.5 with a 40-stage T column, saving $0.6M/yr and giving reward 0.540 with $65.9M/yr C3 revenue. Root boil-up 5.5 was harmful and larger stage cuts save little, so preserve all R899 settings. Copying it secures the best valid design before considering any final change.
